name: Blade of the Exile / Wind Slash

values.meaning: Wind Slash damage amplification from target's missing health (interpolates base damage from minimum to maximum), capped at 75% missing health
values.quote: increased by {{as|{{pp|type= target's '''missing''' health|key=%|0 to 200 for 9|key1=%|0 to 75|formula=2.667% per 1% missing health. ''This is capped at 200% bonus damage at 75% missing health.''}}|health}}
values.binNote: No dedicated data value for the missing-health ratio; only MinBase/MaxBase and their AD ratios are stored, and the interpolation formula between them is presumably computed elsewhere (tooltip-only text).

values.meaning: Bonus attack damage gained while empowered
Delay before the empowerment bonuses (bonus AD, range, Wind Slash availability) take effect after cast
values.quote: All bonuses are gained after {{fd|0.5}} seconds of the ability starting its cast.
values.binNote: Not present as a separate DataValue in the sheet; the bin's own cast time is 0.25s but the wiki notes bonuses apply after 0.5s, a possible discrepancy between cast animation and effect application.

mechanics.claim: The bonus attack damage amount from Blade of the Exile is locked in at the moment of casting and does not update if bonus AD changes afterward.
mechanics.quote: The {{as|'''bonus''' attack damage}} amount is factored upon cast, and does not change.

mechanics.claim: Blade of the Exile's cooldown begins only after its effect (the 15-second empowerment) ends, not on cast.
Wind Slash's three missiles form a cone and each enemy can only be hit and damaged by one of the three missiles (no multi-hit stacking on a single target).
mechanics.quote: Each enemy can be damaged by only one missile.

mechanics.claim: Casting Wind Slash counts as an ability activation, triggering on-cast effects like Spellblade.
mechanics.quote: ''Wind Slash'' counts as an ability activation for the purposes of on-cast effects such as {{tip|Spellblade}} and triggering {{ais|Force Pulse|Kassadin}} passive.

mechanics.claim: Wind Slash's damage can be blocked by a spell shield.
